searchText: Am I right that in order to avoid slow full sync on the CL side, one has to enable checkpoint sync? And checkpoint sync is not enabled by default; to enable it you need an already synced node or Infura? So a new node joining the main net will have to rely on Infura to avoid very slow full syncing? This doesn't sound particularly decentralized to me. I’d suggest reading about weak subjectivity before approaching this topic: https://notes.ethereum.org/@adiasg/weak-subjectvity-eth2 ok, thank you, will do TL;DR Because of the weak subjectivity (an inherent PoS property) one must verify the block root at the weak subjectivity checkpoint when bootstrapping or starting a node after being offline for a while. This verification can be done in many different ways, asking your friend about the root at the checkpoint, double checking with services and block explorers. Ideally, you do several ways to prove the same checkpoint to make this process BFT. Without WS checkpoint verification syncing with the network is insecure in PoS disregarding whether it's a sync from genesis or from a state at the WS checkpoint. You also might want to read this https://notes.ethereum.org/Mp5Iv4N0Qb-d6KZvNuBspg ... it would be nice to know why the people behind that Tweet thought they had authoritative information on this topic. It's not determined yet. projected is q2 2022 so could be around there CL call in 50 minutes. First half dedicated to kiln/merge https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/501 A date for the Ethereum mainnet proof-of-stake transition has not been set as of the publication of this post. excerpts.author: m.kalinin
excerpts.content:
TL;DR Because of the weak subjectivity (an inherent PoS property) one must verify the block root at the weak subjectivity checkpoint when bootstrapping or starting a node after being offline for a while. This verification can be done in many different ways, asking your friend about the root at the checkpoint, double checking with services and block explorers. Ideally, you do several ways to prove the same checkpoint to make this process BFT. Without WS checkpoint verification syncing with the network is insecure in PoS disregarding whether it's a sync from genesis or from a state at the WS checkpoint.

You also might want to read this https://notes.ethereum.org/Mp5Iv4N0Qb-d6KZvNuBspg
